domain.description: Domain slug. Must match the filename stem.

name.description: Current official product name. Null means this cloud has no equivalent.

formerly.description: Names this was previously sold under. Readers search for these because stale courses still teach them.

id.description: Stable dotted identifier, e.g. net.firewall.instance. Never reuse or renumber.

concept.description: The vendor-neutral thing being compared. Never a product name.

divergence.description: exact: the mental model transfers. partial: it maps but behaves differently in a way that changes answers. none: no honest equivalent.

breaks_when.description: REQUIRED unless divergence is exact. What actually differs, concretely enough to change a decision. This field is the product.

shared_trap.description: A caveat that applies identically to all three clouds. Use this when the mapping is genuinely exact but there is still something people get wrong, so that breaks_when keeps its strict meaning of 'where the mapping lies'.

exam_tags.description: Exam codes where this shows up, e.g. SAA-C03, AZ-104, ACE.

sources.description: Documentation pages supporting the breaks_when claim, not marketing pages.

verified.description: ISO date this row was last checked against vendor documentation.
